Schaeffler is a dynamic global technology company and its success has been a result of its entrepreneurial spirit and long history of private ownership. Does that sound interesting to you? As a partner to all of the major automobile manufacturers, as well as key players in the aerospace and industrial sectors, we offer you many development opportunities.
 General Introduction
 Are you an experienced software developer who enjoys building desktop applications and working with engineering software? Join Schaeffler’s team developing the Bearinx Simulation Suite, a portfolio of CAE tools that supports engineers throughout product development - from simulating complete drive trains to analyzing contact conditions in rolling bearings.
In this role, you will design, develop and maintain reliable desktop applications that help our engineering teams solve complex challenges. You will work closely with users and colleagues across disciplines to turn requirements into practical, high-quality software.
 Your Key Responsibilities
Clarify requirements with our customers to ensure a precise understanding of their needs and expectations.
Develop, test and improve software using C++, C# and Python.
Develop maintainable software and contribute to the design of application architecture.
Create intuitive user interfaces and integrate applications with engineering methods and simulation workflows.
Write and maintain automated and manual tests; investigate defects and improve software quality, performance and reliability.
Document software, interfaces and workflows.
Collaborate with an international, cross-functional team and contribute to planning and delivery of project milestones.
Share knowledge with users and other stakeholders and contribute to the future development of the applications.
 Your Qualifications
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a comparable field
Proven experience in software development, especially developing desktop applications.
Strong programming skills in C++ ,C# and Python.
Familiarity with AI-powered software development tools, such as GitHub Copilot or similar, and the ability to use them effectively and responsibly in daily development work.
Experience with object-oriented programming, software design and maintainable code.
Experience with desktop user-interface development and software testing.
Familiarity with version control, particularly Git; experience with Jira or similar project-management tools is an advantage.
Understanding of Agile software development practices.
Interest in engineering simulation or mechanical engineering; experience with CAE applications is an advantage.
Good written and spoken English. German language skills are an advantage.
Structured and analytical working style, initiative and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international team.
 Our Offering
Onboarding & Integration: we help you settle in quickly through our onboarding program and a team that supports you;
Health & Life Insurance: we provide private health plans and life insurance, so you can have peace of mind;
Discounts: enjoy discounts from our partners on activities, trainings, goods etc.;
Bookster Subscription: are you a passionate reader? Then you can borrow your favorite books from the Bookster Library;
Professional Development: with our variety of projects and teams, you'll be able to learn new skills, develop and shape the career path that fits you best;
Bonuses: performance bonuses reward your achievements, and through referral bonuses we thank you for helping our team grow;
Gift for Special Occasions: celebrate Easter, 8th of March or the Winter Holiday;
Vacation Days: we truly believe in long-term partnerships, and we’re committed to supporting your well-being with a generous vacation policy from the start of your journey with us;
Meal Tickets: we’re happy to offer meal tickets as part of your everyday benefits, helping make your lunch breaks more enjoyable;
Flexibility: you can balance your work and personal life with arrangements tailored to your job and responsibilities.
 As a global company with employees around the world, it is important to us that we treat each other with respect and value all ideas and perspectives. By appreciating our differences, we inspire creativity and drive innovation. In this way, we contribute to sustainable value creation for our stakeholders and society as a whole. Together, we advance how the world moves.
Exciting assignments and outstanding development opportunities await you because we impact the future with innovation. We look forward to your application.
